name: v3.72.0 — MCP 2026-07-28 support + 39 contributor fixes
body:
3.72.0 brings ruflo's MCP server up to the [MCP 2026-07-28](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/changelog) revision ([ADR-524](https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo/blob/main/v3/docs/adr/ADR-524-mcp-2026-07-28-dual-era-stdio.md), #4837). It also merges 39 contributor fixes and tests from the [#4775](https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo/issues/4775) tracker and the daily security scan through [#4825](https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo/pull/4825). Thanks to every contributor.

## MCP 2026-07-28
`ruflo mcp start` now serves 2026-07-28 clients and older ones from the same process.
- **No more pinned version.** `initialize` used to answer `2024-11-05` whatever the client asked for. It now echoes a supported version (`2025-11-25`, `2025-06-18` or `2024-11-05`) and reports the real ruflo version.
- **`server/discover`** is answered, so a 2026-07-28 client's stdio probe finds ruflo.
- **Stateless requests.** A request that carries its version in `_meta` gets `resultType` and `serverInfo` on the result. An unsupported version is refused with `-32022` and the list of versions ruflo supports.
- **Stable tool list.** `tools/list` is sorted by name and carries cache hints, so the catalogue is identical on every call and client prompt caches keep hitting.
- **Tracing.** A W3C `traceparent` from the client is passed through to the tool call.

The Tasks extension and the HTTP server's move to 2026-07-28 are planned next (ADR-524, Phase 2).

## Security
- **pre-bash blocks a command it cannot check.** Before, late, unparsable or malformed hook input let the command through (#4743, #4826). The input window for pre-bash is now 3 s, so a slow host still gets its commands checked.
- **Browser tools** accept only http(s) and `about:blank` URLs. Screenshots are written inside the project. A project's Ollama `baseUrl` no longer receives your `OLLAMA_API_KEY` (#4812).
- **Statusline** runs sqlite3 without a shell and strips control characters from directory and git names (#4745, #4818).
- **Imports and federation:** `memory_import` and `session_import` are capped at 16 MiB, and a gzip bomb is refused. `x_federation_join` restricts `keyFile` and `relayWs` (#4754, #4821).
- **Denial of service:** exclusion patterns are matched without regex backtracking (ReDoS), and `performance_benchmark` iterations are capped (#4753, #4820).
- **AIDefence:** the new `RUFLO_AIDEFENCE_PACKS` (`true`, `false` or a comma list of packs) selects the pattern packs for the MCP server (#4785).

## Data integrity
- A corrupt workflow, hive-mind or swarm store is backed up and reported instead of being reset and saved over (#4737, #4779).
- `patterns.json` is merged under the writer lock, so the daemon no longer erases patterns written by hooks (#4735, #4819).
- `daemon.log` rotates, and worker metric files are written atomically (#4740, #4816).

## Fixes
- **Cost tracker 0.31.2:** `cost-health` installs an npx CLI once before running its four checks in parallel, so a cold npm cache no longer breaks the install. A failed `memory list` is reported as an error instead of "no budget set" (#4711, #4827).
- **Hive-mind:** `maxAgents` is enforced; join requires a registered agent and a valid role (#4727, #4813).
- **Swarm:** `swarm_shutdown` terminates members, and an unknown id is an error (#4726, #4815).
- **Tasks:**
  - `task_assign` refuses finished tasks and unknown agents (#4725, #4778).
  - `task_retry` honours `resetState` (#4723, #4807).
- **Agents and terminals:**
  - The `agent_list` status filter accepts `all`, aliases and any case (#4732, #4777).
  - `terminal_execute` refuses closed sessions (#4730, #4789).
  - A heartbeat for an unknown node is an error (#4731, #4786).
- **Embeddings and hooks:**
  - `embeddings_generate` honours `normalize:false` (#4724, #4780).
  - A confidence of 0 is kept instead of being replaced by the default (#4728, #4790).
  - `hooks_model-route` honours `preferCost`/`preferSpeed` (#4722, #4817).
- **CLI flags** that the parser camelCases are now read: guidance, neural, ruvector, hooks coverage, worker detect and single-command flags. A lint test stops new kebab-only reads (#4716–#4721).
- **Windows:** doctor uses `os.homedir()`; GCS and RVFA paths are native; no `2>/dev/null` redirects in `execSync` (#4768–#4770).

## Tests and docs
New tests for MCP tools that had none (#4759–#4767). README counts and the plugin table are refreshed, and there is a ruRE plugin guide. Every plugin manifest has a `repository` field (#4756–#4758, #4771, #4774).

## Packages
`@claude-flow/cli`, `claude-flow` and `ruflo` 3.72.0 on `latest`. 3.71.5 was never published; its changes ship here. Plugins: ruflo-workflows 0.7.2, ruflo-plugin-creator 0.4.5, ruflo-cost-tracker 0.31.2.
